Turn on Require Picking Inventory Parts?
close

You will click Pick on each inventory and found part to record that it has been pulled.

57 parts at this location are affected by this requirement today. No record is changed by this switch.

off.dialog:
Turn off Require Picking Inventory Parts?
close

Inventory and found parts will be ready as soon as their line is approved.

Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in. None of them is picked retroactively.
